entities.name: Mondassian Colony Ship
entities.description: A spacecraft traveling from Mondas to pick up colonists, whose flight deck and lowest floor experienced extreme time dilation near a black hole.

entities.name: Dining Car
entities.description: Part of a spacecraft that reproduced the Orient Express, traveling in space along hyperspace ribbons.

events.summary: The Mondassian Colony Ship nearly traversed into a black hole, causing a thousand years to pass on its lowest floor in under two and a half days on the flight deck.
events.quote: When the ship almost traversed into a black hole
